items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Ron directly; the interviewer mentions Ron in questions, but the interviewee's responses do not confirm a personal relationship or interaction with Ron.

ctx.x: Yeah, I do some of the ballads today. I do the Cry Pretty Baby. The ballads were- The Cry Pretty Baby and Misery. I don't do that much anymore. Whenever you change his band you got to get the pieces to direct them to the changes and the measurements and the balls and all.
But you did have a big record for Ron, going to Mardi Gras New Orleans the second time you did it.
Yeah, that was also Mr. Joe Osanto's doctor. I believe that was for his brother-in-law, Joe Rufino. Joe Rufino. And- Now that's still popular.
